tour_main_export_body.message: Click Export when you are ready. Large chats and image-heavy PDFs may take longer because images are prepared safely.

tour_main_filename_body.message: The file name comes from the chat title. You can edit it before exporting.

tour_main_filters_body.message: Use All, Response, Prompt, Images, or None to quickly control what is selected.

tour_main_format_body.message: Choose PDF, HTML, PNG, DOCX, Markdown, JSON, TXT, or CSV depending on what you need.

tour_main_messages_body.message: Select the exact messages you want to export. The selected counter shows how many will be included.

tour_main_settings_body.message: Open Settings for language, loading-screen behavior, branding, page options, and provider-specific controls.

tour_main_start_body.message: Use this Export button to open the export sidebar. You can drag it anywhere on the page.

tour_settings_branding_body.message: Use branding and icon controls when you want cleaner files for sharing or professional delivery.

tour_settings_language_body.message: Choose the extension display language here. Save/reload open AI pages to apply the new language everywhere.

tour_settings_prompt_body.message: You can also learn where language, loading-screen behavior, branding, page options, and provider controls live.

tour_settings_providers_body.message: Provider tabs are where ChatGPT, Claude, DeepSeek, Gemini, and Grok-specific behavior lives.

tour_settings_saved_body.message: Use this Save button after changing options. It confirms immediately, so you do not need to scroll to the bottom.

tour_settings_sections_body.message: General covers common export behavior. Providers contains platform-specific controls.

tour_settings_skip_download_body.message: When enabled, files download automatically after export. The support/modal flow can still appear after completion.

tour_settings_skip_loading_body.message: This keeps long exports feeling lighter by using the small progress notification instead of the full loading page.

tour_welcome_new_body.message: Export your AI chats by opening the export sidebar, choosing messages, editing the file name, selecting a format, and starting the export.

tour_welcome_update_body.message: AIChatExporterPro has a cleaner export flow, better sidebar controls, stronger PDF/HTML handling, and many fixes since the previous version. Thanks for your patience.
